author: Will N. (Will Nathaniel) Harben

longDescription: Harben is a novel likely written in the late 19th century. The story follows two young aeronauts, Harry Johnston and Charles Thorndyke, who find themselves in an extraordinary situation after their balloon crashes on a mysterious island.

authorInfo.bio: Will N. (Will Nathaniel) Harben (1858–1919) is the author of The Land of the Changing Sun. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
